security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU does not always implement the mip or mie CSR (e.g., traps on access when a dependent extension is disabled), or mie writable bits do not match the set of actually-pending interrupt sources, or read-only-zero mie bits are silently writable
security_spec.summary: mie must always be present and its writable bits must exactly match implementable interrupts; a missing mie CSR or writable read-only-zero bits lets the guest enable non-existent interrupt vectors, potentially triggering undefined handler dispatch
